buyer: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
title: Consultancy framework agreement for formulation, appraisal and review of Danish development cooperation programmes and projects
description: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark (MFA) is in the process of streamlining the management of its development cooperation. Part of this effort concerns the simplification of the procurement process of key consultancy services relating to development cooperation. Consultancy contracts are currently procured individually by the case worker responsible for the programme or project. Case workers are MFA staff from MFA Services at Home and Services Abroad. They are responsible for the procurement process of individual contracts which is often lengthy, and can have implications on programme and project implementation timelines. Moreover, the fragmentation of the process makes it difficult to use the feedback from case workers on the fulfilment of the assignments. This makes it challenging to harvest learning from past performance and ensure a sustained quality of services. It is in this context that the MFA wishes to consolidate the procurement of consultancy services through a framework agreement with multiple contractors. The streamlining of the management of Danish development cooperation entailed a revision of the Danida – Aid Management Guidelines (AMG). This foresees a delegation of key tasks to external consultants, primarily appraisals, and thereby an expected rise in the number of consultancy services to be requested. It is therefore an opportune time to seek a more streamlined procurement process of consultancy services. The AMG’s Bilateral Guidelines (https://amg.um.dk/bilateral-cooperation/guidelines-for-programmes-projects-country-strategic-frameworks-and-hard-earmarked-multilat-support) and Financial Management Guidelines (https://amg.um.dk/bilateral-cooperation/financial-management) constitute the basic set of procedures for all Danish bilateral development cooperation. The guidelines outline the processes and requirements for the preparation, formulation, quality assurance, approval, implementation, completion and closure of Danish bilateral programmes and projects. The purpose of the framework agreement is to make the MFA procurement of key consultancy services relating to Danish bilateral development programmes and projects more effective and efficient by ensuring quick access to relevant specialists, reducing the procurement time for assignments, and improving the quality of services provided. The objective of the framework agreement is to have a contractual set-up between the MFA and a number of contractors who can provide, upon demand and in a timely manner, the required expertise and service quality for the formulation, appraisal and review of Danish bilateral development programmes and projects. The objective of each assignment and the required outputs will be described in the Terms of Reference, which will be part of the Delivery Contract for the individual assignment. The Framework Agreement solely covers Denmark’s bilateral development cooperation programmes and projects. Therefore, the scope of work of consultancy services solely pertains to Official Development Assistance (ODA) funds. The framework agreement is divided into two lots that reflect the thematic areas and priorities of Denmark’s Strategy for Development Cooperation: Lot 1: Climate, environment, private sector and financing. Lot 2: Governance, fragility, and migration. The framework agreement will require the provision of the following services pertaining to the design and implementation phases of bilateral development cooperation programmes, namely: Formulation of bilateral programmes and projects. This may include preparatory work in the formulation process if and as needed. Appraisal of the design of bilateral programmes and projects as a quality assurance milestone prior to approval. This includes external appraisals led by the consultant and early appraisals of larger or high-risk programmes/projects led by LÆRING. Review of bilateral programmes and projects under implementation. This can span inception, midterm and technical reviews covering the full implementation period of the programme/project as part of the MFA unit’s monitoring and reporting cycle. Reviews do not have the same scope of work, methodology and methods as an evaluation. The MFA’s definition of appraisal, review and evaluation services is aligned with the definitions provided by OECD/DAC (https://one.oecd.org/document/DCD/DAC/EV(2022)2/en/pdf). The content of the services will vary and be defined by the MFA in the specific Terms of Reference for each individual assignment. The following themes and types of services will not be part of the framework agreement: Research and university partnerships. Training programmes and tracer studies. Culture. NGO strategic partnership agreements with the MFA (SPA agreements). Core support to multilateral organisations as described in Danish Organisation Strategies. Strategic Sector Cooperation. Audit assignments. Legal assessments. Monitoring, evaluation, accountability and learning (MEAL) unit contracts and multi-year MEAL technical assistance. Evaluations. Tender process consultancies. Please refer to the Consultancy Framework Agreement and Appendix 1 Scope of Services for a more detailed description of the object of the procurement.

Για την εκτέλεση των ανωτέρω υπηρεσιών, ο ανάδοχος θα πρέπει να διαθέτει: Α) κατάλληλο προσωπικό: • 14 εργάτες καθαριότητας Β) απαιτούμενο υλικοτεχνικό εξοπλισμό: • Σακούλες απορριμμάτων μαύρες μεγάλες 120Χ120 εκ. & σακούλες μικρές για τα καλαθάκια • Ασβέστες για το άσπρισμα των οδών • Λοιπά υλικά και εργαλεία (βούρτσες, σκούπες, καρότσια ,κλπ) για τον καθαρισμό των οδών • Υλικοτεχνικό εξοπλισμό για τις εργασίες αποψίλωσης και κλαδεμάτων (χορτοκοπτικά, φτυάρια, πριόνια χειρός και βενζίνης, τσάπες, σκάλες κλπ) • Μέσα ατομικά προστασίας για τους εργαζόμενους. Για τις λοιπές ανάγκες του έργου, όπως περιγράφονται στην παρούσα, ο Δήμος θα παραχωρεί στον ανάδοχο κατάλληλα οχήματά του, αναλόγως των αναγκών και της διαθεσιμότητας. Ο ανάδοχος για την εκτέλεση των ανωτέρω εργασιών υποχρεούται να απασχολεί εργάτες καθαριότητας με εξαρτημένη σχέση εργασίας και με πλήρες ωράριο εργασίας, ως ακολούθως: - από την υπογραφή της σύμβασης και για χρονική διάρκεια 18 μηνών : 468 ημέρες x 14 εργάτες καθαριότητας = 6.552 ημερομίσθια με πλήρες ωράριο εργασίας, για τις εργασίες αποκομιδής απορριμμάτων και καθαριότητας κοινοχρήστων χώρων Δήμου Άνδρου(6 ήμερη απασχόληση). ΣΥΝΟΛΟ ημερομισθίων: 6.552. Η αρχική διάρκεια της σύμβασης ορίζεται σε δεκαοκτώ (18) μήνες από την ημερομηνία έναρξης ισχύος της, με ανώτατο αρχικό φυσικό αντικείμενο 6.552 ημερομισθίων πλήρους απασχόλησης και ανώτατη αρχική συμβατική αξία 511.711,20 € χωρίς ΦΠΑ. Η Αναθέτουσα Αρχή διατηρεί δικαίωμα προαίρεσης, το οποίο μπορεί να ασκηθεί, εν όλω ή εν μέρει, με αιτιολογημένη απόφαση του αρμοδίου οργάνου πριν από τη λήξη της αρχικής συμβατικής διάρκειας, εφόσον εξακολουθούν να υφίστανται ανάγκες παροχής των ίδιων υπηρεσιών και εξασφαλίζεται η απαιτούμενη δημοσιονομική κάλυψη. Το δικαίωμα προαίρεσης αφορά πρόσθετη διάρκεια έως εννέα (9) μήνες, πρόσθετο φυσικό αντικείμενο έως 3.276 ημερομίσθια πλήρους απασχόλησης και πρόσθετη αξία έως 255.855,60 € χωρίς ΦΠΑ, ήτοι έως ποσοστό 50% του αρχικού φυσικού και οικονομικού αντικειμένου. Σε περίπτωση πλήρους άσκησης της προαίρεσης, η συνολική διάρκεια της σύμβασης δεν μπορεί να υπερβεί τους είκοσι επτά (27) μήνες, ο συνολικός αριθμός ημερομισθίων τα 9.828 και η συνολική αξία τα 767.566,80 € χωρίς ΦΠΑ. Η άσκηση της προαίρεσης δεν μπορεί να μεταβάλει τη συνολική φύση της σύμβασης και αφορά αποκλειστικά τις υπηρεσίες και τις τεχνικές προδιαγραφές που περιγράφονται εξαρχής στα συμβατικά τεύχη. Ο Δήμος δύναται να αναπροσαρμόζει την κατανομή των ημερομισθίων τόσο ανά Δημοτική Ενότητα (χωρικά), όσο και ανά χρονική περίοδο (χρονικά), αναλόγως των αναγκών του Δήμου. Η παρεχόμενη υπηρεσία κατατάσσεται στους ακόλουθους κωδικούς του Κοινού Λεξιλογίου δημοσίων συμβάσεων (CPV): 90600000-3 : “Υπηρεσίες καθαριότητας και εξυγίανσης σε αστικές ή αγροτικές ζώνες, καθώς και συναφείς υπηρεσίες” Αναλυτική περιγραφή του φυσικού και οικονομικού αντικειμένου της σύμβασης δίδεται στο ΠΑΡΑΡΤΗΜΑ Α της παρούσας διακήρυξης. (αρ. μελέτης: 10/2026) Η σύμβαση θα ανατεθεί με το κριτήριο της πλέον συμφέρουσας από οικονομική άποψη προσφοράς, βάσει της τιμής.

buyer: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
title: Denmark – Foreign economic-aid-related services – Consultancy framework agreement for formulation, appraisal and review of Danish development cooperation programmes and projects
description: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark (MFA) is in the process of streamlining the management of its development cooperation. Part of this effort concerns the simplification of the procurement process of key consultancy services relating to development cooperation. Consultancy contracts are currently procured individually by the case worker responsible for the programme or project. Case workers are MFA staff from MFA Services at Home and Services Abroad. They are responsible for the procurement process of individual contracts which is often lengthy, and can have implications on programme and project implementation timelines. Moreover, the fragmentation of the process makes it difficult to use the feedback from case workers on the fulfilment of the assignments. This makes it challenging to harvest learning from past performance and ensure a sustained quality of services. It is in this context that the MFA wishes to consolidate the procurement of consultancy services through a framework agreement with multiple contractors. The streamlining of the management of Danish development cooperation entailed a revision of the Danida – Aid Management Guidelines (AMG). This foresees a delegation of key tasks to external consultants, primarily appraisals, and thereby an expected rise in the number of consultancy services to be requested. It is therefore an opportune time to seek a more streamlined procurement process of consultancy services. The AMG’s Bilateral Guidelines (https://amg.um.dk/bilateral-cooperation/guidelines-for-programmes-projects-country-strategic-frameworks-and-hard-earmarked-multilat-support) and Financial Management Guidelines (https://amg.um.dk/bilateral-cooperation/financial-management) constitute the basic set of procedures for all Danish bilateral development cooperation. The guidelines outline the processes and requirements for the preparation, formulation, quality assurance, approval, implementation, completion and closure of Danish bilateral programmes and projects. The purpose of the framework agreement is to make the MFA procurement of key consultancy services relating to Danish bilateral development programmes and projects more effective and efficient by ensuring quick access to relevant specialists, reducing the procurement time for assignments, and improving the quality of services provided. The objective of the framework agreement is to have a contractual set-up between the MFA and a number of contractors who can provide, upon demand and in a timely manner, the required expertise and service quality for the formulation, appraisal and review of Danish bilateral development programmes and projects. The objective of each assignment and the required outputs will be described in the Terms of Reference, which will be part of the Delivery Contract for the individual assignment. The Framework Agreement solely covers Denmark’s bilateral development cooperation programmes and projects. Therefore, the scope of work of consultancy services solely pertains to Official Development Assistance (ODA) funds. The framework agreement is divided into two lots that reflect the thematic areas and priorities of Denmark’s Strategy for Development Cooperation: Lot 1: Climate, environment, private sector and financing. Lot 2: Governance, fragility, and migration. The framework agreement will require the provision of the following services pertaining to the design and implementation phases of bilateral development cooperation programmes, namely: Formulation of bilateral programmes and projects. This may include preparatory work in the formulation process if and as needed. Appraisal of the design of bilateral programmes and projects as a quality assurance milestone prior to approval. This includes external appraisals led by the consultant and early appraisals of larger or high-risk programmes/projects led by LÆRING. Review of bilateral programmes and projects under implementation. This can span inception, midterm and technical reviews covering the full implementation period of the programme/project as part of the MFA unit’s monitoring and reporting cycle. Reviews do not have the same scope of work, methodology and methods as an evaluation. The MFA’s definition of appraisal, review and evaluation services is aligned with the definitions provided by OECD/DAC (https://one.oecd.org/document/DCD/DAC/EV(2022)2/en/pdf). The content of the services will vary and be defined by the MFA in the specific Terms of Reference for each individual assignment. The following themes and types of services will not be part of the framework agreement: Research and university partnerships. Training programmes and tracer studies. Culture. NGO strategic partnership agreements with the MFA (SPA agreements). Core support to multilateral organisations as described in Danish Organisation Strategies. Strategic Sector Cooperation. Audit assignments. Legal assessments. Monitoring, evaluation, accountability and learning (MEAL) unit contracts and multi-year MEAL technical assistance. Evaluations. Tender process consultancies. Please refer to the Consultancy Framework Agreement and Appendix 1 Scope of Services for a more detailed description of the object of the procurement.

The teams work largely independently, but at the same time have dependencies and a need for coordination in relation to direction, priorities and goal achievement. The product area is newly established and as product area manager the consultant ́s main task is to cooperate with the product teams to find an appropriate organisation of the area going forward. At the same time, it will be important to develop and manage the area strategy for Land animals together with the teams, facilitate clear priorities across the teams, manage dependencies and ensure good coordination with the sponsor group and other interested parties. In addition, area managers must follow-up that the area together creates the desired results and effects in accordance with the Norwegian Food Safety Authority's strategies and ambitions.

title: Norway – Systems and technical consultancy services – Procurement of consultancy services - Product area manager for the land animal product area.
description: The objective of the procurement is to strengthen the Norwegian Food Safety Authority ́s work in product development through an experienced consultant who, through the role of product area manager, shall support the establishment and further development of the Land animal product area. Landdyr product area currently consists of four product teams with different areas of responsibility where there are dependencies between the teams and functions in other parts of the organisation. The area of responsibility is broad and comprises everything from digital inspection systems for land animals, a meat control system on slaughterhouses, personnel approval, use of veterinary medicines, as well as central registers. Over time, teams have built up considerable domain knowledge and worked independently with their assignments, but there is a need to appear uniform, and together ensure effects across which contribute to increased food safety, animal health and animal welfare. The consultant ́s main task is to coordinate and support this cooperation, and together with the product managers contribute to establishing clear frameworks for organisation, management and interaction in the product area. The work shall build on the teams ́ existing competence, experience and ownership of the domain. The assignment involves supporting the development of a common area strategy with clear aims and priorities in line with the organisation's strategic ambitions. The consultant shall contribute to establishing good forms of work for overall decisions, handling dependencies and follow-up of the area ́s results and effects in cooperation with the product managers, the management group in the Development Department and other relevant interested parties. A central goal of the assignment is to strengthen the product area ́s ability to develop a common direction and cooperate across time. The consultant shall therefore emphasise the involvement, transfer of competence and ownership of the existing product managers, so that the Norwegian Food Safety Authority can continue the product area management after the assignment has concluded.

title: Denmark – Rehabilitation hospital services – Udbud af Rehabiliteringsydelser på specialiseret niveau
description: Kommende Region Østdanmark udbyder en kontrakt vedrørende levering af specialiseret rehabilitering til patienter med behov for et intensivt, tværfagligt og specialiseret rehabiliteringsforløb. Formålet med udbuddet er at sikre regionens patienter adgang til rehabiliteringsydelser af høj faglig kvalitet, leveret af leverandører med de nødvendige specialiserede kompetencer, kapacitet og organisatoriske rammer. Leverandøren skal understøtte sammenhængende patientforløb gennem tæt samarbejde og koordinering med regionens hospitaler, kommuner og øvrige relevante aktører. Ydelserne omfatter døgnbaserede rehabiliteringsforløb for patienter, der efter sygehusbehandling har behov for fortsat specialiseret rehabilitering med henblik på at opnå størst mulig funktionsevne, selvstændighed og livskvalitet. Udbuddet gennemføres af Region Hovedstaden og Region Sjælland på vegne af den kommende Region Østdanmark, som vil være kontraktpart ved kontraktens ikrafttrædelse.
